content.text: No MFN burdening Ono exists; the only MFN-style term runs in Ono's favour. Submitting a compliant finding without a redline.

input.quote: Array shall not require Ono to place orders directly with a Subcontractor if such Subcontractor is unwilling to fulfill such orders on terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array.
input.rationale: Targeted searches for most-favoured-nation, "no less/more favorable terms", right-to-match, best-pricing and preferential-terms mechanics returned nothing that obliges Ono (Customer) to extend Array any terms it gives third parties. The single MFN-flavoured provision, Section 9.3(b), runs in Ono's favour: Array may not force Ono to order directly from a Subcontractor unless that Subcontractor will supply Ono on terms as favourable as those it gives Array. The only other "favorable" hits are a withholding-tax rate clause (§VII) and a benefit/risk safety clause (Term and Termination), neither of which is an MFN. This meets the preferred position (no Customer MFN obligation), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
mappings.quote: Array shall not require Ono to place orders directly with a Subcontractor if such Subcontractor is unwilling to fulfill such orders on terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array.
